The Detect Image Anomalies tool creates an anomaly score raster from an input multiband or hyperspectral image. The anomaly score raster is a single band raster with values between zero and one.

The multiband or hyperspectral image containing the anomalies to be detected.

The method used to detect anomalies.

The polygon feature layer that defines the region used to calculate background statistics. This parameter only appears if Anomaly calculation method is set to RXD or UTD.

Specifies whether statistics are recomputed for the input raster when Anomaly calculation method is set to RXD or UTD, which require accurate statistics to perform. If checked, statistics are recomputed for the input raster. If unchecked, statistics are not recomputed.

The number of clusters to use if Anomaly calculation method is set to KMEANS.

The name of the layer that will be created and added to the map.

The type of output that will be created. The output can be a tiled imagery layer or a dynamic imagery layer.

The name of the folder in My content where the result will be saved.
